name: corpse_removed_unseen
about: An ordinary mortal's corpse nobody sees is removed ten seconds after the death. The damage_lethal_death staging (an idle TutorialThug on the east pad, TakeDamage 10000 at 3 s) with the player turned away: the player stands at the start facing yaw -135, the east pad 180 degrees behind the view. CBaseCombatCharacter::CreateCorpse 0x1032c0e0's tail arms SUB_PVSRemove 0x102696f0 at curtime + 10.0 (0x1032c404) on an ordinary mortal's corpse; the think re-arms itself every 10 s while any player passes all three of the view cone (slot 363 FInViewCone), the PVS test (0x101d1a90) and FVisible(corpse, mask 0x2804091) (slot 201), and otherwise calls UTIL_Remove 0x101cd940 (stories/v4/packets-S1.md item 1; stories/v1/triage.md, Judge's rulings, V4 -- second sitting, J13). Unseen at the first think, the corpse is removed at death + 10 s: one `removed` event on arena_victim, none before death + 9.5 s.
notes: The death is at 3.0-3.1 s (the queued input lands the frame after the script's 3.0), so death + 10.5 s is 13.6 and death + 9.5 s is 12.4. The watched half is corpse_kept_seen. GREEN on the V4a seam's build (the think is ported: ElysiumNpc.cpp, the dead think's SUB_PVSRemove), so it carries no known_red; it is the first consumer of the `removed` kind (H22), and V4c's C integrator and V4d (the simulating body removed) must keep it green.
